hook: Blood clones with several cancer driver mutations can sweep the blood decades before leukemia is diagnosed
hook_turn: can sweep the blood decades before leukemia is diagnosed
summary: Yearly blood samples taken up to 15 years before acute myeloid leukemia diagnosis were deep-sequenced and fitted with evolutionary theory. First drivers arise early in life and grow slowly, while later drivers give up to 100-fold larger growth advantages. The cohort is limited to people who went on to develop leukemia, so predictive power in the general population is not established.
title: Evolutionary dynamics in the years preceding acute myeloid leukaemia.
